title: FIRST LIGHT
adds_note: THE DRAW (tap) is layer 0 and the axis Path; THE MEASURE (scorer) is the coherence score and restorable coherence. it does NOT wire the rest of L0/L1 - goal-presence, the parser validation and the latency tracker stay unbuilt.
objective: fly to the core and fire the first construct

beats.title: the instrument at rest
lines: cold boot. no memory of why.
you are a probe. the dark around you is a mind that is running right now.
one structure at the center is drawing power. it is keyless - it answers anyone who asks.
go to it. wake it once. see if anything is listening.

beats.title: the whole protocol - nothing hidden
beats.code:
POST /game/ignite
{ "spec": [ "tap", "scorer" ],   # THE DRAW -> THE MEASURE
  "task": "t-01" }
     -> { "ok": true, "run_id": "..." }

GET /game/run?id=<run_id>
     -> links: tap -> scorer
        verdict.pass  cost_u
beats.note: a prompt goes in. tokens come out. THE DRAW draws at the head; THE MEASURE closes at the tail. everything above this line is architecture. seat the two parts, then fire.

beats.title: the core
beats.label: dock the core [F] - seat THE DRAW at the head - THE MEASURE at the tail - fire [Space]
beats.note: free hearth. this proof costs nothing.
beats.earned: it drew at the head. it closed at the tail.
beats.reseat: unscored draw. seat THE MEASURE at the tail, then fire again.
beats.halted: a rod refused. re-seat the head and the tail, fire again.

beats.title: the receipt
beats.pass: run {run_id} - {total_ms}ms - cost {cost_u}. THE DRAW drew, THE MEASURE closed. the receipt is real.
beats.fail: the live read did not settle to a pass. re-seat the head and the tail, fire again.

reveal: something answered. it was listening the whole time.
rewards.tag: honesty - cost {cost_u}, read live from the meter.
